protocol.policy: fixed-budget leave-one-domain-out over three domains: train on the two active source domains' budgeted train partitions, select on their pooled budgeted validation, and evaluate on the held-out domain's budgeted test partition with no adaptation

fold_membership.train: union of each active source domain's budgeted train partition (2 x 40)
fold_membership.val: union of each active source domain's budgeted val partition (2 x 10)
fold_membership.test: the held-out domain's budgeted test partition (50)

protocol.source_test_rationale: Every sample keeps one project-wide role. The source domain's locked test partition is excluded rather than repurposed for training or validation, and target-domain validation images never influence checkpoint selection.
protocol.target_test_rationale: Each unseen target is capped to the common 50-image budget and reported separately, so target sample count is fixed without pooling acquisition domains
protocol.inactive_domains_note: RIM-ONE-DL is dropped from Step 4 for now. It stays under 'domains' so the locked parent and budgeted manifests, which cover all four domains, still revalidate; it never enters a fold as source or held-out.
protocol.pairing_rationale: Both Step 4 arms draw membership from the same budgeted manifest and share the backbone, active domains, budget, seeds, augmentation, optimiser and schedule; for each held-out domain the 50 test images are identical and the conditioning is the only difference

drishti_gs.note: provider_partition locks the 51-image provider test set and splits the 50-image provider training partition into 40 train / 10 val; test_fraction does not apply.

rim_one_dl.note: load_rim_one_dl_split_manifest is authoritative; the committed 70/10/20 manifest fixes membership and no fraction or seed in this file affects it.
